configuration.frame_count_rule: 2 orientations * selected frequencies * 4 phases * acquired states + raw diversity states
limitations: Frame counts are sequential sample exposures and exclude amortized clean-reference acquisition.
No camera readout overlap, polarization-on-chip simultaneity, exposure time, motion, or hardware switching latency is claimed.
Selection on this simulator can overfit its assumed optical constants and residue families.

selected_v2_1.early_exit_semantics: Early exit is valid only for an FOV-level FLAG; a complete pixel map and every PASS require all 44 frames.
